svg.title: Building a training utterance out of single-word clips
svg.desc: Four panels: a raw one-second clip with the kept part shaded; four trimmed words placed on a timeline with random gaps; the same timeline with background noise added at 10 dB signal-to-noise ratio; and the log-mel spectrogram of the result.
svg.text: Building a training utterance out of single-word clips
1. A ONE-SECOND CLIP OF "SEVEN": THE ENDPOINT DETECTOR FINDS THE WORD, THE REST IS THROWN AWAY
2. FOUR TRIMMED WORDS ON A TIMELINE, RANDOM PAUSES BETWEEN THEM: "SEVEN STOP DOWN ONE"
3. PLUS BACKGROUND NOISE (DOING THE DISHES) AT A SIGNAL-TO-NOISE RATIO OF 10 DB
4. WHAT THE NETWORK IS GIVEN: 40 LOG-MEL BANDS EVERY 10 MS (THEN NORMALIZED)
